# Zaflick

> Zaflick is an Indian athleisure brand, made by Zaflick Lifestyle Pvt. Ltd. Its line is "Whatever the plan, you're in": clothes for good times with friends, and one outfit that is ready for any plan (a walk, a game, a coffee, a day out) and looks good throughout, with no changing in between. Zaflick is in pre-launch, starting in Hyderabad and Bengaluru. Prices have not been announced, and every product image on the site is a concept until the real samples are photographed. The first drop opens to the Circle (Zaflick's free early list) first.

Key facts:
- The first drop is five pieces. For women: sports bra (medium support), active legging with a deep side pocket that holds a phone, fitted jacket. For men: active T-shirt (boxy, drop-shoulder). Unisex: wide-leg pants (drawcord waist).
- A tank top with built-in support and athleisure shorts follow in the next drop, March–April.
- Launch: December, starting with Hyderabad and Bengaluru, Circle members first. Men's pieces are expected from mid-December, women's pieces from 1 January.
- Founders: Rahul Raja Dunna and Hemanth Kumar Jami, both from Visakhapatnam. Rahul, the first in his family to go into business, studied computer science, has an MBA from IIM Amritsar and a background in data science, with work in sales, political strategy and product development. Hemanth studied computer science engineering and is a traveller and creative professional with a background in photography (weddings and wildlife).
- Designed style-first in India, made in small batches and sold direct. Designed after surveying nearly 200 people and interviewing more than a dozen about what goes wrong with activewear in India.
- Fabric chosen for heat and humidity. Zaflick is testing the fabric for see-through, pilling and shape. Sizing is built on Indian measurements.
- The Circle (free): see the real samples first, buy 48 hours before the public launch, free shipping on the launch order. Members get a personal link to bring a friend.
- Zaflick is starting sessions in Hyderabad.
- Ships in India to start.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/houseofzaflick/
